channel.title: HotNews — China, every day.
channel.description: Daily stories about China in technology, finance, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, science, travel and culture — for readers around the world.

item.title: AI Takes Over Sophisticated Investment Scams
item.description: Chinese investors face new wave of AI-powered financial fraud as artificial intelligence enables more sophisticated 'pig butchering' scams that manipulate victims into transferring large sums.

item.title: China's Smartphone Giants Switch Chip Suppliers
item.description: Major Chinese phone makers OPPO and vivo unexpectedly switch to MediaTek chips for flagship models, signaling industry shifts amid intense competition.

item.title: Donkey Kong's Final Banana Bash Delights Gamers
item.description: Nintendo wraps up a year of themed events with the 'Banana Frenzy Carnival' expansion in Donkey Kong: Banana Bliss. The week-long event offers players non-stop challenges on the 1400th underground level.

item.title: Vivo Unveils X500 with Cutting-Edge MediaTek Processor
item.description: Chinese smartphone manufacturer vivo launches its latest flagship models featuring new MediaTek chips, continuing China's innovation in mobile technology.

item.title: China's Tea Traditions in Modern Times
item.description: From ancient ceremonies to contemporary tea houses, China's 5,000-year tea culture continues to evolve while preserving its deep-rooted traditions.

item.title: The Ancient Art of Chinese Shadow Puppetry Meets Modern Light
item.description: Chinese shadow puppetry, a millennia-old storytelling tradition using intricately carved leather figures, is experiencing a cultural revival. Contemporary artists and theaters are preserving this UNESCO-recognized art form by blending classic tales with modern lighting and digital projection techniques.

item.title: Chinese Animation Industry Captures Global Imagination
item.description: China's animation sector has evolved from domestic productions to internationally acclaimed works, blending traditional cultural elements with cutting-edge technology to win global audiences.

item.title: China's Coffee Capital Brews a Global Financial Stir
item.description: Shanghai has quietly become the world's most crowded coffee market, turning a daily caffeine habit into a fierce commercial arena. This beverage boom is now drawing major consumer-finance attention as global funds pour capital into domestic chains.

item.title: Beats 360: Redefining Wireless Audio Experience
item.description: Apple's audio brand Beats unveils its first new over-ear headphones in three years, the Beats 360, combining premium sound with innovative design to mark two decades of audio innovation.

item.title: China's Quantum Leap: Leading the Next Computing Revolution
item.description: China's rapid advancements in quantum computing technology position it as a key player in the next frontier of computational science, with breakthroughs that could transform industries worldwide.

item.title: China's Running Revolution: Marathon Culture Blooms
item.description: Once a nation of cyclists, China has embraced running marathons with unprecedented enthusiasm, creating one of the world's largest and most vibrant running communities.

item.title: China Launches Satellite Internet Constellation
item.description: China successfully deployed another batch of low-earth orbit satellites, continuing its ambitious space-based internet project with the launch of 26 satellite groups.

item.title: China's High-Speed Rail Network Connects Ancient and Modern
item.description: China's expanding high-speed rail network transforms travel across the world's most populous nation, connecting historic sites with modern cities at unprecedented speeds.

item.title: China's C919: The Homegrown Airliner Taking to More Skies
item.description: Developed by COMAC, the C919 narrow-body jet is expanding from its first commercial routes into a growing fleet. Here is what makes China's flagship passenger plane tick — and what it is like to fly on one.

item.title: China's EV Exports Are Redrawing the Global Auto Map
item.description: China is now the world's largest vehicle exporter, led by electric and plug-in hybrid cars from BYD, Chery and a wave of younger brands — a shift with big consequences for car prices everywhere.

item.title: Marathon Madness: How Running Became China's Weekend Ritual
item.description: From mega-city marathons with lottery entry to trail races in the mountains, tens of millions of Chinese runners have turned weekend racing into a national pastime.

item.title: Blockbusters and Records: Chinese Animation Grows Up
item.description: From Ne Zha's record-smashing runs to a new wave of studios, Chinese animated films have become a box-office force at home — and are eyeing audiences abroad.

item.title: A Nation of Tea Drinkers Falls for Coffee
item.description: China now runs one of the world's largest coffee markets. From Shanghai's specialty roasters to app-driven chains, coffee has quietly become part of everyday urban life.

item.title: Tiangong: Life and Science Aboard China's Space Station
item.description: Permanently crewed by rotating teams of three taikonauts, the Tiangong station hosts hundreds of experiments — and is opening its modules to payloads from around the world.

item.title: Seeing China at 350 km/h: A Practical High-Speed Rail Guide
item.description: With over 45,000 kilometers of high-speed lines linking megacities and ancient towns, China's bullet-train network is the fastest way for visitors to see the country. Here is how to use it.

item.title: Hanfu Revival: Young China Reclaims Traditional Dress
item.description: Flowing sleeves in city parks, hanfu photo studios and a multibillion-yuan market — traditional Chinese clothing has moved from costume play to everyday fashion.
